# karmanivero.us

> Jason Williscroft's site: essays on software engineering and life, plus open-source TypeScript libraries, AWS and DynamoDB tooling, and the Jeeves AI assistant platform. API documentation for each project lives at https://docs.karmanivero.us/<project>/.
